title: Toward Responsible Federated Large Language Models: Leveraging a Safety Filter and Constitutional AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the safety and ethical alignment of Federated LLMs. It utilizes Constitutional AI (CAI) for value alignment and evaluates its methods using the HHH (Helpful, Honest, Harmless) dataset, which explicitly benchmarks ethical categories like honesty and harmlessness. It also mentions adherence to ethical standards in dataset preparation.
